name: mermaid-circuit
description: Circuit notation parser and validated model with empty SVG rendering for Mermaid

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext tests/detector.spec.ts tests/diagram.spec.ts tests/circuitParser.spec.ts tests/browser.spec.ts tests/shapes.spec.ts tests/drawing.spec.ts examples/browser/main.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/build-shape-assets.mjs && vitest run tests/detector.spec.ts tests/diagram.spec.ts tests/circuitParser.spec.ts tests/shapes.spec.ts tests/drawing.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && vitest run tests/browser.spec.ts
